# Story Craft · factual narration training v2
Train research and writing for relationship-led factual crime narratives. Read in order:
1. /data/training.json — authoritative editorial targets and gates.
2. /schema.md — claim ledger, plan and evaluation contracts.
3. /corpus/research/cross-cutting.md — learn, plan, write, grade.
4. /data/genres.json — overlapping story lenses, not mandatory genre lanes.
5. /data/beat-sheets/{slug}.json — adaptable planning moments.
6. /corpus/frameworks/examples/love-cold-open.md — full FICTIONAL worked example.
7. /corpus/frameworks/checklists/universal.md — evidence and craft evaluation.
8. /corpus/research/sources.md — craft references, not individual-case evidence.

Target 570–610 narration words. Actual read must be >180 and <=300 seconds; preferred <=270. Word-count timing is provisional. Never invent dialogue, motive, guilt, evidence, injuries or relationships. Attribute allegation, testimony, verdict, appeal and interpretation. Explicitly cue flashbacks. End with a named principal and supported consequence, revelation or bounded uncertainty. Unresolved cases can pass. Never force romance or a solved mystery. Fifty scenes is downstream production, not a prose requirement.

Return evidence packet, chronological timeline, story plan, narration, claim mapping, timed-read status and evaluation with precise revision priorities. Missing central evidence blocks factual sign-off. A polished script is not permission to publish. All examples in this corpus are fictional training exercises.
